description: This file defines the WatchReplyCoordinator class, which manages the processing and queuing of quick reply events in a watch interface. It handles deduplication, queuing when the gateway is disconnected, and decision-making for forwarding or dropping events.

classes.name: WatchReplyCoordinator
classes.description: A coordinator class responsible for managing watch quick reply events, including deduplication, queuing, and forwarding decisions.

methods.name: ingest
methods.description: Processes an incoming WatchQuickReplyEvent, deduplicates, queues if gateway is disconnected, or forwards the event.

methods.name: drainIfConnected
methods.description: Returns queued events if the gateway is connected and clears the queue.

methods.name: requeueFront
methods.description: Inserts an event at the front of the queue for reprocessing.

methods.name: queuedCount
methods.description: Returns the number of queued reply events.
